Yes,
Edan Instruments
distributes ambulatory and portable diagnostic tools
through its regional operations—such as its Asia-Pacific operational hub,
Edan Medical (Thailand) Co., Ltd.
—though their core focus centers on clinical-grade portable monitors and diagnostic equipment rather than consumer wearables.
Edan

Edan Instruments
does not manufacture consumer smartwatches, continuous glucose monitors (CGMs), sleep trackers, or general consumer wellness wearables
. Instead, their Asia-Pacific and global product lines focus on professional clinical diagnostics, hospital telemetry, diagnostic ECG systems, and clinical remote/ambu-latory cardiac and patient monitoring.
Edan
Professional Clinical Offerings vs. Consumer Wearables
Wearable ECG & Mobile Diagnostics:
Edan offers professional wireless ECG acquisition modules (such as the DX12 PADECG system) and dual-function dynamic ECG/blood-pressure recorders (like the SA-20) rather than consumer wristwatches.
Edan
Remote Patient & Telemetry Monitoring:
Their clinical remote infrastructure includes the iT20 telemetry transmitter and iT30/50 systems, which act as hospital-grade wearable solutions tracking 3/5-lead ECG, SpO2, and respiration for indoor mobile patients.
Edan
Continuous Non-Invasive Blood Pressure (CNBP):
Rather than standard cuffs or consumer fitness bands, Edan uses Pulse Wave Transit Time (PTT) derived from ECG and SpO2 signals via their CNBP technology for continuous clinical patient evaluations.
Edan
Glucose & Sleep Trackers:
Edan has no active commercial products or commercialized research lines for consumer continuous glucose monitors or wrist-worn sleep tracking bands.
